scope: Feature/scope matrix: enumerate local resources, online integrations, missing content and pedagogical extensions, each tagged with a per-resource policy (parity / offline_adaptation / external_absent). Pure synthesis of existing docs and already-extracted static evidence; no new binary/Unity/device work performed.

authorized_rules_sources.role: Author-authorized local prices/rewards for the offline economy (shop, gifts, pass). Explicitly NOT recovered from the original server.
Screen/control-by-control matrix of what the original does vs. what the local client implements, with explicit non-parity callouts.
Product-level framing: offline functional reconstruction including a fictional economy and pedagogical challenges; defines the pedagogical activity as optional and never a Play substitute.
Explicit adaptation rule: AW coins come from pedagogical activities (literacy etc.) instead of real-money purchases -- this is the product's intentional differentiator, not a reverse-engineering gap.
